title: LTFRB fast-tracks permits for 1,003 Undas buses

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) is fast-tracking special permit applications for 1,003 buses ahead of the All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day holidays. Acting LTFRB Chairman Greg Pua said the board received 356 applications covering the buses, which will serve routes in various parts of the country during the Undas period. “We are reviewing all the data that we have to determine the appropriate number of passenger buses that will be given special permits,” Pua said.
